fields.statement: Verifier at 83447746. Read the diff: ShipCheckRequest gains --reruns (ShipReruns; an explicit 0 decodes to -1 so 0 and negatives are usage errors, absent means 1); shipRerunFailed counts reruns per head (RerunCount, legacy states with Reruns count as 1), resets on a new head, and writes the state file with the new count before calling gh run rerun --failed; the --main dispatch path gets the same budget. go test -trimpath ./internal/api/ -run TestShip -count=1: ok (TestShipCheckRerunBudget: --reruns 2 reruns run 42 twice with RerunCount 1 then 2 in the ship record, the third red settles failed with no third gh rerun, a new head reruns again with count reset to 1; TestShipCheckRerunDefaultOnce: no flag reruns once, then fails; TestShipCheckRerunsUsage: reruns 0 and -1 give CodeUsage). A scratch build run as rhiza ship check --reruns 0 and --reruns -2 both exit 2 with a usage message, so the argv path goes through the same decoding. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(run-ship-rerun|describe-golden)': run-ship-rerun-pass, run-ship-rerun-fail (both unchanged by the diff) and describe-golden PASS; the golden carries the new reruns flag. A full ./internal/api run with Budget tests skipped had 0 failing tests; the package was marked FAIL only by the post-run guard on ~/code/.rhiza-root/usage.live.json (the live root daemon's usage file, unrelated to this diff), and TestReadBudget/TestReadBudgetApply timing failures came from load 11-17 on 4 cores and do not touch ship code.
